c74object.name: evi.damp~
c74object.digest: Onepole pass/shelf damping filters with simultaneous outputs
c74object.description:
evi.damp~ is a 'max define' for the evi_damp.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.damp~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Two very efficient damping filters in series. A lowpass/highshelf filter (left outlet) and a highpass/lowshelf filter (right outlet). The frequency and damping inlets control both filters simultaneously for high level attenuation control. Useful for damping in reverbs and other situations. With the 'damp' inlet at 0.71..0.99 the first lowpass outlet is similar to MSP [onepole~] (depending on Hz).

inlet.description: The center frequency around which the filters damp the input signal.

The amount of damping. A special normalised control: 0 = the filters are bypassed, 1 = the left filter is lowpassed and the right filter is highpassed. Between 0..1 the filters are attenuating shelves.

outlet.description: Lowpass/Highshelf damped filter output. With damp 0.71..0.99 this outlet is similar to MSP [onepole~] (depending on Hz).

attribute.name: smoothdamp
attribute.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the damping input control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.

attribute.name: smoothfreq
attribute.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the frequency input control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.

c74object.discussion: Most of the evieve reverbs use some form of these filters internally.
